name: codex-wake-me-up
description: Host-local durable monitors for guarded Codex goal continuation.

interface.shortDescription: Guarded local defer and wake-up monitors for Codex goals.
interface.longDescription: Arms a typed host-local monitor and conservatively defers or continues one guarded Codex goal when its condition is met.
defaultPrompt: For a long same-host job, conservatively defer my active goal and arm one guarded wake-up monitor.
